forced_actions.scope: Seven distinct selected actions from three exposed roots. Identical q4 continuation for both actors. Actual conditional events, not original policy comparison, independent WDL or strength.

static_horizon.decision: Changed approximate horizon does not restore original requested q4. At1second neither hardstop root gets deeper retained iteration. At8seconds only second root reaches changed-objectiveD2; no immediate safety or utility gain established. No product/default adoption.

lazy.bootstrap_scope: 5000 resamples of eight families, both dependent roles kept together. Descriptive development interval; not randomized-causal inference, WDL or population strength.

upfront.bootstrap_scope: 5000 resamples of eight families, both dependent roles kept together. Descriptive development interval; not randomized-causal inference, WDL or population strength.

prospective_policy.game_cost_scope: Physical baseline played once per family and reused for both role comparisons; pairs are correlated. Whole/game cost includes scientific recording. Caller cost excludes Core/audit/file saves. Changed trajectories are not same-work speed comparisons.

q0_component.scope: Posthoc EXPOSED component baseline on all original eight families/two roles, existing q4 control reused. Not new validation or changed old outcomes.

measurement_scope.observed_source: probe.schedule: phase record_value finishes before caller_seconds; final selected record_value follows that measurement, and execution_allowed checks the same original deadline after it.
measurement_scope.budget_consequence: Execution eligibility includes the final selected-record copy; shared main+q accounting and selected actions/outcomes remain unchanged. No hard final-return or physical-transition deadline is claimed.
measurement_scope.cost_consequence: Recorded caller_seconds/overrun_seconds omit the final duplicate research selected-result serialization. They are not a complete end-to-end stopwatch. Full game/batch wall includes that cost and other scientific I/O, apart from writing its own final receipt. Use those totals for total-cost interpretation.
measurement_scope.correction: No frozen fields or caps rewritten. New fixed-node controls also record an outer stopwatch around schedule; original clock-limited games remain immutable.

limits: UNKNOWN contributes zero only to observed finite W-L statistic, not a draw or missing-outcome imputation. All categorical transitions remain explicit.
